label: Bedwars Stats
tagline: Hypixel Bedwars stats, urchin score and blacklist tags in chat.
description: Viewer commands backed by urchin.gg: daily, weekly and monthly Bedwars sessions, lifetime stats, the Urchin sniper score and active blacklist tags. Commands default to your linked Minecraft account; viewers can also name any player, e.g. "!daily Technoblade".

account.label: Linked Minecraft account
account.help: Default player for every command. Leave blank to use your Twitch username. The bot stores the account UUID when Mojang allows it, so commands keep working after a rename.

daily.tagline: Bedwars session since the daily reset.

weekly.tagline: Bedwars session since the weekly reset.

monthly.tagline: Bedwars session since the monthly reset.

stats.defaultMessage: {player}: {stars} stars · {wins} wins · {finals} finals · {fkdr} FKDR · {beds} beds broken

tags.tagline: Active Urchin blacklist tags (also !bwtags, !bw tag or !bedwars tag).

commands.bw: Look up Hypixel Bedwars stats or blacklist tags.
commands.daily: Show Bedwars stats since the daily reset.
commands.weekly: Show Bedwars stats since the weekly reset.
commands.monthly: Show Bedwars stats since the monthly reset.
commands.sniper: Show the Urchin sniper score for a player.
commands.tagdescription: Show Urchin blacklist tags with their reasons.
